notesI18n.zh:
· 目录筛选标签右键（手机长按）可看完整路径、文件夹/文件数量，并能直接打开该目录（Windows / macOS）
· 目录名过长自动截断到 20 字符，完整名在悬浮提示和右键菜单里
· 目录标签默认只显示 3 行，多出来的点「更多」展开、点「收起」收回
notesI18n.en:
· Right-click (long-press on mobile) a directory filter tag to see its full path, folder/file counts, and open it in the file manager (Windows / macOS)
· Long directory names are truncated to 20 chars; the full name stays in the tooltip and the context menu
· Directory tags show only 3 rows by default — expand with "More" and fold back with "Collapse"
